text: Does your sister work in a hospital ?

provenance.reference: Tata response in this chat, 13 October 2026, to transform My sister works in a hospital into a question, after material, worked example and hint my sister = she.

limits: Supported grammar practice, not official IELTS or independent ability evidence.

feedback.explanation: Does + singular subject + base verb work is correct. My changed to your; natural when asking the coach, but a strict transformation keeps my. Correct original transformation: Does my sister work in a hospital? Remove the space before question mark in standard English punctuation.
feedback.next_task: One independent set of 12 question transformations, explicitly preserving original subjects.
